name: The Drowned Archive
introDiscord:
The kingdom's library stretches through flooded halls packed with
books, scroll tubes, maps, floating pages, and Royal Archive Wisps that
take overdue materials extremely seriously.
introTwitch:
The kingdom's library stretches through flooded halls packed with
books, scroll tubes, maps, floating pages, and Royal Archive Wisps that
take overdue materials extremely seriously.

the-drowned-archive-approach.prompt: The Drowned Archive opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A sealed bookcase hides Star Candies behind a volume titled:

ROYAL FEASTS OF THE THIRD DYNASTY.

Shizuki bookmarked the dessert section.

right.message:
A reading alcove contains restorative tea salts.

Her review:

'Library tea.

Excellent.

Book tried floating away during sip.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message:
An Archive Wisp sees you touching an unregistered scroll.

Library enforcement arrives immediately.

the-drowned-archive-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Drowned Archive, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Wisp protects a tower of floating books.

right.message:
One Berry marks Shizuki's place in a cookbook.

Her note:

'Recipe says simmer gently.

I do not know how to simmer underwater.

Research suspended.'

forward.message:
A map cabinet contains Star Candies and several kingdom maps that
actually make sense.

Shizuki's annotations do not.

the-drowned-archive-threshold.prompt: Near Scriptorium of Bubbles, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A librarian's desk contains a sealed candy tin.

right.message: An Archive Wisp blocks access to restricted shelves.

forward.message:
Shizuki left a restorative beside a stack marked:

'Books I definitely intended to put back.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Scriptorium of Bubbles
boss-antechamber.prompt: Thousands of pages rise inside the Scriptorium of Bubbles.

bossPromptDiscord:
Thousands of pages rise inside the Scriptorium of Bubbles.

They arrange themselves around one brilliant Wisp wearing a tiny
spectral librarian's crown.

Use /yes to approach or /no to avoid the world's most
aggressive late fee.
bossPromptTwitch:
Thousands of pages rise inside the Scriptorium of Bubbles.

They arrange themselves around one brilliant Wisp wearing a tiny
spectral librarian's crown.

Use !yes to approach or !no to avoid the world's most
aggressive late fee.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Scriptorium of Bubbles. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The pages return to their shelves.

One cookbook floats open to the berry tart recipe.

Shizuki circled it seven times.
